title: Ultimaker 3 enclosed 3D printer
objects_and_counts: One enclosed desktop 3D printer is visible occupying the frame; the front face shows a rectangular door/opening and internal build area.
No people are visible in the image.

Inside the printer, visible components include one build plate (glass-looking, horizontal) and one print head/carriage assembly suspended on horizontal rails; two vertical guide rods are visible at the rear of the build area.
An external-looking clear/transparent upper enclosure panel is visible attached to the top of the printer (count: one).
There are multiple fasteners/screws visible on the machine panels (individually visible but not counted as repeated inventory).
spatial_relations: The transparent front panel forms the main viewing window; the build plate lies horizontally near the bottom of the interior directly behind this front window.
The printer carriage with the 'Ultimaker' label is mounted on a horizontal rail spanning the upper interior and sits above the build plate.
Two vertical metal rods are positioned toward the rear of the interior, behind the carriage, running from the base toward the top of the enclosure.
A tall cylindrical/box-shaped white component is located at the right-rear interior, behind the carriage and near the right interior wall.
A clear/transparent top panel is attached above the main body, forming an upper enclosure that sits above the visible interior components.
colours_and_materials: The printer's exterior body is predominantly white plastic.
Front and upper panels appear to be clear transparent material (likely acrylic or polycarbonate) allowing an unobstructed view of the interior.
Interior guide rods and some structural rails are metallic (silver/steel appearance).
The build plate appears dark on its surface and rests on a glass-looking substrate with a greenish tinge at the front edge.

The precise wording/format of the printer model marking (for example superscript formatting) is interpreted as 'Ultimaker 3' but exact glyph details may differ.
Some interior parts (for example whether the cylindrical rear unit is a filament spool holder or another component) cannot be identified confidently from appearance alone.
Fasteners, small stickers and any fine-print safety or certification labels are present but unreadable in this image.
